description: Pressing Esc during keyboard navigation immediately clears navigation mode and the item focus ring, and restores the original scale.

assertions.comment: After Esc, the root keyboard navigation state turns off immediately.
After Esc, the first item keyboard focus is cleared.
After Esc, the first DockItem focus-ring child path is not visible.
After keyboard mode ends, the scale returns to the default 1.0.
